title: sigmund~

messages.description: with -t: table name, points, first point, sample rate, debug flag
pitch in MIDI by default, the arguments choose the outlets

arguments.description: sets outlets and types: pitch, notes, env, peaks, tracks

flags.name: -npts <float>
flags.description: set number of points in each analysis window (default 1024)

flags.name: -hop <float>
flags.description: set number of points between each analysis (default 512)

flags.name: -npeak <float>
flags.description: set number of sinusoidal peaks for 'peaks' output (default 20)

flags.name: -maxfreq <float>
flags.description: set maximum sinusoid frequency in Hz (default 1000000)

flags.name: -nharmonics <float, float>
flags.description: rolloff harmonic and octave bias for pitch detection (default 6 0)

flags.name: -amppowerlaw <float>
flags.description: power applied to amplitude in pitch spectrum (default 0.5)

flags.name: -quality <float>
flags.description: minimum pitch quality to report a pitch (default 0.4)

flags.name: -vibrato <float>
flags.description: set depth of vibrato to expect in semitones (default 1)

flags.name: -stabletime <float>
flags.description: set time in ms to wait to report new notes (default 50)

flags.name: -minpower <float>
flags.description: set minimum amplitude in dB to report a new note (default 50)

flags.name: -growth <float>
flags.description: set amplitude growth in dB to report a repeated note (default 7)

methods.description: set number of points in each analysis window
set number of points between each analysis
set number of sinusoidal peaks for 'peaks' output
set maximum sinusoid frequency in Hz
rolloff harmonic and (optionally) octave bias for pitch detection
power applied to amplitude in pitch spectrum
minimum pitch quality to report a pitch
set depth of vibrato to expect in semitones (for note output)
set time in ms to wait to report new notes (note output)
set minimum amplitude in dB to report a new note (note output)
set amplitude growth in dB to report a repeated note (note output)
forget previous analisys for tracks output
print version number and current parameters

body: [sigmund~] analyzes a sound into sinusoidal components, which it can report individually or combine into a pitch estimate. The arguments choose its outlets: pitch, notes, env (amplitude), peaks and tracks. Flags and messages set the analysis parameters, and with -t it analyzes an array instead of its signal input.
